newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi King Fahd congratulates Britain's Blair.
newsitem.headline: Saudi King Fahd congratulates Britain's Blair.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd on Friday congratulated new British Premier Tony Blair on his election victory and said he looked forward to further strenghthening the ties between the two countries.

"I am pleased to stress on this occasion the friendship and close ties between our friendly countries and their common aspirations in strengthening them, in reinforcing security and stability and in achieving peace in the Middle East and all world regions in a climate of justice and high human values," King Fahd said in a message carried by the Saudi Press Agency.
